channel.title: Boca Libre Updates
channel.description: Secure, signed updates for Boca Libre.

item.description:
# Boca Libre 0.3.7
- Keeps the slender dictation capsule available between dictations instead of making it disappear. - Removes the distracting “Inserted” confirmation flash after successful dictation. - Uses one stable, high-contrast capsule for ready, listening, and transcribing states. - Shows Boca Libre, privacy, and Apple or OpenAI provider marks at a glance. - Explains every capsule symbol when you hover over it. - Shows the current dictation shortcut until microphone capture begins for the first time after launch. - Remembers where you drag the capsule across launches. - Uses Right Option as the default shortcut on fresh installations.

# Boca Libre 0.3.6
- Starts the listening indicator only after microphone capture has actually begun, for both Apple and OpenAI transcription. - Buffers the opening words while the selected transcription engine initializes, removing visible startup latency without losing speech. - Drives the waveform directly from live microphone input so it never lags behind by replaying buffered audio levels. - Replaces the large listening message with a slimmer, draggable waveform capsule. - Shows an Apple-and-lock mark for private on-device transcription and a cloud mark for OpenAI transcription. - Gives Keychain items clear, user-visible names and explains whether access enables learned corrections or OpenAI cloud transcription. - Checks for a saved OpenAI key at startup without decrypting it; the key is read only when OpenAI transcription is used.

# Boca Libre 0.3.5
- Adds comprehensive study-specific profiles spanning neuro, spine, chest/cardiac, body imaging, ultrasound, genitourinary, MSK, breast, molecular imaging, vascular, fluoroscopy, and interventional radiology. - Adds an explicit top-100 term ranking for general radiology and every study profile; rank and tier now control Apple model weights and OpenAI hint order. - Uses Apple Dictation with a private, study-focused custom language model for Radiology mode on macOS 26 and newer. - Adds balanced normal/abnormal phrase patterns and high-yield reporting language without mixing unrelated study vocabularies. - Gives accepted personal corrections progressively more weight in the local Apple language model. - Prepares and caches custom models locally while keeping startup bounded and falling back safely if preparation is incomplete. - Removes derived language-model caches when personal corrections are cleared.

# Boca Libre 0.3.3
- Makes the dictation indicator slimmer and draggable, and remembers its position across launches and display changes. - Improves capitalization and punctuation when inserting text inside browser-based editors and existing sentences. - Avoids adding a terminal period when an editor cannot safely expose the text after the cursor. - Prevents cumulative Apple transcription hypotheses from being inserted as repeated text. - Preserves more of longer dictations and removes pause-generated ellipses from the newer Apple on-device engine.

# Boca Libre 0.3.2
- Introduces a calmer Boca Libre identity built around an open speech bubble and a gentle breath wave. - Uses a monochrome menu-bar icon that automatically follows macOS light and dark appearance. - Keeps the new mark crisp and recognizable at small sizes.
